Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Create ONE polished portrait main gameplay screen for Magnet Sort, based on the existing screen in image 1. Image 1 is the edit target and primary art-direction reference. Image 2 is ONLY a supporting reference for thin solid hex chips, readable top-group counters, and matching chip/cell geometry; do not copy its logo, blue background, tray, ads, avatar or platform chrome.

Preserve the original rich violet/electric blue patterned background, MAGNET SORT logo, cream and gold beveled HUD panels, purple pause button, three glossy horseshoe magnet selectors without any symbols, selected violet glow, cream dock, purple/gold Hint and Restart buttons. All UI text in English: "LEVEL 3", "CLEARED 0 / 18", "MOVES", "5", "Choose a magnet and an empty tile", "Hint", "Restart". Maintain the premium glossy casual Facebook puzzle game finish and original portrait composition, approximately 941x1672.

Redesign ONLY the central hex playing board and pieces. Use a tightly tessellated regular honeycomb of cream inset hex cells with consistent seams, a single shared plane and camera projection. All cells AND chips must be FLAT-TOP hexagons (horizontal top and bottom edges), identical orientation and matching six-edge silhouettes. No random gaps, disconnected tiles, broken outlines, mismatched angles or floating stacks. Each chip fits centrally and snugly within its cell with a consistent small inset. Moderate elevated 3D view so every thin layer is visible on the front sides.

Replace thick hollow hex rings with SOLID thin beveled hex chips, NO central holes. Thickness about 4% of chip width. Separate discrete readable thin slabs, restrained bevel/highlight, violet/cyan blue/coral orange palette. Show exactly THREE stacks on three separated board cells with empty neighboring cells. Precisely count every slab:
A, upper-left: exactly SIX chips total, bottom TWO blue chips plus top FOUR violet chips. A single white bold dark-outlined number "4" centered on the top violet face.
B, upper-right: exactly SIX chips total, bottom ONE coral chip plus top FIVE blue chips. A single number "5" centered on the top blue face.
C, lower-left: exactly SIX chips total, bottom TWO violet chips plus top FOUR coral chips. A single number "4" centered on the top coral face.
Thus exactly 18 real depicted chips across the board. Top numbers count only the uninterrupted top-color run, not the whole stack. Each slab has ONE side wall and ONE fine boundary; no decorative extra slab lines. Keep 2 slate obstacle cells with subtle X, consistent with original design, away from stacks.
Main screen is at rest, no pieces in flight, no trails, no fake motion. Show solid upper faces and precise flush resting positions. Stacks do not obscure each other or the HUD; ample room for taller stacks. No extra badges, currencies, tooltips, design annotations, smartphone device frame, watermark or Russian text.
Output ONE finished standalone screen, not a contact sheet, not a presentation board. Preserve decorative UI art from image 1 faithfully; the new geometry and readable counters are the focus.
